integrity: Analytical proof supplied. Finite computational checks corroborate it; they are not exhaustive proof. Originality remains qualified by possible unindexed weighted results.
scientific_limitations: Counting-measure formula is already established in arxiv:2005.03146; no claim of independent publication priority, arbitrary graphs, non-Hilbert exponents, or approximation hardness. NP-completeness is weak.
scientific_scope: Exact weighted strong L2 norm, all extremizers and mass-partition NP-completeness for centered complete-graph metric-ball maximal averaging, |V|>=2 and positive finite masses.
title: Sharp weighted \(L^2\) complete-graph maximal norm and one-third mass rigidity
